title: Going Beyond Hyperscaler Clouds in the Sky Ecosystem with SkyPilot | EECS at UC Berkeley
content: Going Beyond Hyperscaler Clouds in the Sky Ecosystem with SkyPilot | EECS at UC Berkeley Going Beyond Hyperscaler Clouds in the Sky Ecosystem with SkyPilot Edward Zeng EECS Department, University of California, Berkeley Technical Report No. UCB/EECS-2023-179 May 17, 2023 http://www2.eecs.berkeley.edu/Pubs/TechRpts/2023/EECS-2023-179.pdf SkyPilot is an intercloud broker being developed at UC Berkeley. Until recently, SkyPilot only supported three hyperscaler clouds: AWS, Azure, and GCP. In this report, we document the addition of a new cloud, Lambda Cloud. We describe the implementation challenges of Lambda Cloud support and discuss how we overcame them. Finally, we provide a guide for adding new clouds to SkyPilot.
